description: This file is a Perl script that functions as a flash utility for D-Link DSL-502T routers, supporting firmware verification, hardware checks, environment configuration, and flashing procedures via FTP.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for ADAM2 bootloader interactions, including login, environment variable retrieval, and reboot commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Send a USER command to FTP

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieve an environment variable from the FTP server

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable value

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Send a reboot command to the device via FTP

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device and close FTP connection
